keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no row for the trust territory (Italian Africa drops Somalia in 1941 and the Federal Republic of Somalia starts in 1960), so the cells are British or nobody's in the compile for 1941-1959. The pages give no area and no boundary line; the gazetteer's Somalia (523,250 km2, Natural Earth, without Somaliland) is the reading of 'former Italian Somaliland'. The Haud and the frontier with Ethiopia were still disputed (the page's reference list has a 1954 UN item 'Question of the frontier between the Trust Territory ... and Ethiopia'); no line is on the page.

region.text: former Italian Somaliland, the Trust Territory under Italian administration (modern Somalia without Somaliland)

ledger.note: 1 April 1950: Italy returns to Mogadishu as UN trustee. 'On 1 April 1950, the Amministrazione fiduciaria italiana della Somalia (AFIS) began its rule'; 'former Italian Somaliland was made a Trust Territory, as stipulated by United Nations General Assembly Resolution 289 of 21 November 1949'; 'The British continued to administer the area until 1 April 1950.' The page names the land as former Italian Somaliland; the country-sized region is the researcher's reading. Italy was suzerain-trustee (colony of republic-of-italy) for ten years.

region.text: former Italian Somaliland, the Trust Territory under Italian administration (modern Somalia without Somaliland)

ledger.note: 1 July 1960: the trust territory joins British Somaliland in the Somali Republic. 'On July 1, 1960, the two territories united as planned to form the Somali Republic.' The Italian Somaliland page gives the same date and adds that the trusteeship 'lasted ten years, from 1950 to 1960'.

region.text: former Italian Somaliland, the Trust Territory under Italian administration (modern Somalia without Somaliland)

ledger.note: 1 July 1960: the Italian trusteeship ends in union and independence (infobox 'Dissolved: 1 July 1960', 'Succeeded by: Somali Republic'). Mogadishu became the capital of the Somali Republic on the same day (Italian Somaliland page).

certainty.note: The trust territory's frontiers with Ethiopia and British Somaliland were colonial-era lines the opened pages do not describe; the Ethiopian frontier was a standing UN question in 1954 (title in the page's references). The coast is sharp.

notes: Written by n-mod. Two pages (the budget). TYPE: colony of republic-of-italy (the orchestrator's note says a colony row of Italy in data/colonies.csv; no such row exists yet, so the compile must add trust-territory-of-somaliland,republic-of-italy,1950,1960). Nothing in the pages dates a mid-trusteeship border change. The 1941-1949 period (British Military Administration of the same land) is british-africa's occupation of Italian Somaliland and is not in this dossier; british-africa ledger 51 ends it in April 1950 with counterpart italian-africa. The federal-republic-of-somalia ledger founds that state from italian-africa in 1960 (its ledger 0) and gains British Somaliland from british-africa; its predecessor should be this slug. The Ethiopian frontier question (UN item of 1954) is not described on either page; the Haud and the Ogaden are not claimed here.
